arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاكْفِنَا طُـولَ الأمَـلِ، وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ حَتَّى لا نُؤَمِّلَ اسْتِتْمَامَ سَاعَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ وَلاَ اسْتِيفَاءَ يَوْمٍ بَعْدَ يَوْمٍ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wākinā ṭūla al-amal, waqaṣṣirhu ʿannā biṣidqi al-ʿamal ḥattá lā nuʾammila istitmāma sāʿatin baʿda sāʿaẗin wa lā istīfāʾa yawmin baʿda yawm
english_text: O God, Bless Muhammad and his Household, spare us drawn out expectations and cut them short in us through sincerity of works, that we may not hope expectantly for completing an hour after an hour, closing a day after a day,

arabic_text: وَلاَ اتِّصَالَ نَفَسٍ بِنَفَس، وَلا لُحُـوقَ قَدَمٍ بِقَـدَم.
transliteration: wa lā ittiṣāla nafsin binafs wa lā luḥūqa qadamin biqadam
english_text: joining a breath to a breath, or overtaking a step with a step!

arabic_text: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ، وَآمَنَّا مِنْ شُـرُوْرِهِ، وَانْصِبِ المَوْتَ بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا نَصْباً،
transliteration: wasallimna min ghururihi, wa amanna min shuroorihi wa-anṣibi al-mawta bayna ʾaydinā naṣban
english_text: Keep us safe from the delusions of expectations, make us secure from their evils, set up death before us in display.
and let not our remembering of it come and go!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِنْ صَالِحِ الأعْمَـالِ عَمَلاً نَسْتَبْطِئُ مَعَهُ الْمَصِيرَ إلَيْكَ، وَنحْـرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأنَسَنَا الَّذِي نَأنَسُ بِهِ،
transliteration: wa-jʿal-lanā min ṣāliḥi al-aʿmāl ʿamalan nastabṭiʾu maʿahu al-maṣīr ilayk wa-naḥrisu lahu ʿalā waškil-liḥāqi bika ḥattá yakūna al-mawtu ma'anasanā alladhī ná'nasu bihī
english_text: Appoint for us from among the righteous works a work through which we will feel the homecoming to Thee as slow and crave a quick joining with Thee, so that death may be our intimate abode with which we are intimate,

arabic_text: وَمَألَفَنَا الَّذِي نَشْتَاقُ إلَيْهِ، وَحَامَّتَنَا الَّتِي نُحِبُّ الدُّنُوَّ مِنْهَا
transliteration: wa ma'alafana allathi nash'taq'u ilayhi, wa hammatana allati nuhibbu addunyawwa minha
english_text: our familiar place toward which we yearn, and our next of kin whose coming we love!

arabic_text: فَإذَا أَوْرَدْتَهُ عَلَيْنَا، وَأَنْزَلْتَهُ بِنَا فَأسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِراً، وَآنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِماً، وَلاَ تُشْقِنَا بِضِيافَتِهِ، وَلا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيارَتِهِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ بَاباً مِنْ أَبْوَابِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ،
transliteration: fa'idhā awradtahu ʿalaynā, wa-anzaltahu binā fa asʿidnā bihi zāʾiran, wa ānisnā bihi qādiman walā tušqinā biḍīāfatih, walā tukhzinā biziyāratih wa-jʿalhu bāban min abwābi maghfiratika
english_text: When Thou bringest it to us and sendest it down upon us, make us happy with it as a visitor, comfort us with its arrival, make us not wretched through entertaining it, degrade us not through its visit, and appoint it one of the gates to Thy forgiveness
and the keys to Thy mercy!

arabic_text: أَمِتْنَا مُهْتَدِينَ غَيْرَ ضَالِّينَ طائِعِينَ غَيْرَ مُسْتَكْرِهِينَ تَائِبينَ غَيْرَ عاصِينَ وَلا مُصِرِّينَ يَا ضَامِنَ جَزَاءِ الْمُحْسِنِينَ، وَمُسْتَصْلِحَ عَمَلِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ.
transliteration: amatna muhtadeen ghayra dhalilin ṭāʾiʿīna ghayra mustakrihīna tāʾibīna ghayra ʿāṣīna walā muṣirrīna yā ḍāminaj jazā' al-muḥsinīn wa mustaṣliḥa ʿamali al-mufsidiin
english_text: Make us die guided, not astray, obedient, not averse, repentant, not disobedient or persisting, O He who guarantees the repayment of the good-doers and seeks to set right the work of the corrupt!
